name: Augmentor: NLP Cloud
description: integrates NLP Cloud as an Augmentor provider (NLP tasks: summarize, classify, generate).
project_description:
NLP Cloud provides cloud-based AI tools which can be used for generating and classifying content. 

 NLP Cloud offers advantages over other well-known AI generative services:

 
 SaaS or on-prem solutions available 
 GDPR compliant with European servers 
 No retention of user data, not even for 30 days, as with other services 
 Wide range of models available 
 Cost-effective 
 
 NLP Cloud Augmentor plugins for integrating with NLP Cloud to improve the editor experience.

 Augmentors provided by this module 
 
 NLP Cloud Blog Post Generation 
 NLP Cloud Classification 
 NLP Cloud Headline generation 
 NLP Cloud Keywords and keyphrases extraction 
 NLP Cloud Summarization 
 NLP CLoud Text generation 
 NLP Cloud Translation 
 
 You can check the following examples https://docs.nlpcloud.com/#endpoints and use the playground on NLP Cloud https://nlpcloud.com/home/playground/ .

 Installation 
 Install as you would typically install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information.

 Configuration 
 Configure the user permissions in Administration » People » Permissions:

 Administer augmentors 

 Users with this permission will see the webservices > augmentors configuration list page. From here they can add, configure, delete, enable and disabled augmentors.

 Requirements 
 
 Augmentor .
